faq.subtitle: GUEST QUESTIONS
faq.description: Everything you need to know about preparing for your visit, our organic products, and spa policies at Aura Spa.

questions.q: Q1. What types of holistic wellness treatments does Aura Spa offer?
questions.a: Aura Spa offers signature full body massages, clinical botanical facials, warm basalt hot stone therapy, foot reflexology, Himalayan salt body scrubs, detoxifying wraps, and private couples sanctuary suites tailored to your personal health goals.

questions.q: Q2. How do I reserve an appointment at Aura Spa?
questions.a: You can easily reserve online via the Book Appointment form on this page or call our concierge desk directly at +100000000000. We recommend booking in advance to secure your preferred date and therapist.

questions.q: Q3. Are your skincare and body formulations 100% natural and organic?
questions.a: Yes. Aura Spa exclusively utilizes premium cold-pressed botanical oils, wildcrafted plant extracts, and cruelty-free mineral formulations free from synthetic fragrances, sulfates, and parabens.

questions.q: Q4. What should I wear or bring to my spa session?
questions.a: We provide plush Egyptian cotton robes, sanitized slippers, private lockers, and organic bath amenities. You do not need to bring anything; simply arrive and allow our team to take care of every comfort.

questions.q: Q5. What is the cancellation and rescheduling policy at Aura Spa?
questions.a: We understand schedules shift. We kindly request at least 24 hours notice for any cancellations or adjustments so we may accommodate other guests seeking relaxation.

questions.q: Q6. Can treatments be customized for sensitivities or pregnancy?
questions.a: Absolutely. During your initial consultation, please share any allergies, pressure preferences, or health conditions. We offer dedicated maternity rituals and unscented botanical formulations.

faqs.question: Q1. What is Aromatherapy Massage?
faqs.answer: Aromatherapy Massage is a therapeutic massage that uses natural essential oils to promote relaxation, reduce stress, relieve muscle tension, and improve overall well-being.

faqs.question: Q2. What are the benefits of Aromatherapy Massage?
faqs.answer: It helps with relaxation, pain management, and improved mood.

faqs.question: Q3. How long does a session last?
faqs.answer: Sessions typically last between 60 to 90 minutes depending on your preference.

faqs.question: Q4. Are there any side effects?
faqs.answer: Aromatherapy is generally safe, but some people may be sensitive to certain essential oils.

faqs.question: Q5. Do I need to book an appointment in advance?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend booking in advance to secure your preferred time.
